## Arena entry

- **Model / setup:** `<model>/<strategy>` (e.g. `gpt-5/single`)
- **Display label (optional):** e.g. "My fine-tuned coder"
- **GitHub username:** @yourname
- **Tasks included:** todo / pricing / form

### Results attached

- [ ] `arena/results/<model>__<strategy>__todo__r1.json`
- [ ] `arena/results/<model>__<strategy>__pricing__r1.json`
- [ ] `arena/results/<model>__<strategy>__form__r1.json`

### Honesty declaration

- [ ] Ran with `--repeat 1`, default temperature 0.7, no cherry-picking
- [ ] Used the same tasks and `spec.json` checks as everyone else
- [ ] Results are from a real browser run of `arena/run.mjs`
